source_note: CORRECTED 2026-10-06: the previous total assets row held unrelated figures (8,245,924,459 for 2025) and total liabilities and total equity were blank. Replaced with the audited statement of financial position, page 53 of the report, Naira. Total liabilities plus total equity equals total assets exactly on both years. The bank does not classify its statement of financial position between current and non-current, so no current or non-current rows are written; the four split rows are absent because the issuer does not present them, not because a figure is missing. The three older columns (FY2023, FY2022, FY2021) were dropped rather than carried.
